question: The National Dental Commission Bill, 2023 introduced by _____ ministry.
solution:
The correct answer is__** ​Health and Family Welfare**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** National Dental Commission Bill, 2023** aims to establish a national framework for the regulation of dental education and practice in India.
 
• The Bill proposes the establishment of the **National Dental Commission (NDC)**, which will be responsible for formulating policies for dental education and practice, as well as maintaining a registry of dental professionals in India.
 
• The **NDC will regulate dental colleges,** set educational standards, and accredit dental institutions.
 
• It aligns with the Ministry's broader goals to enhance healthcare delivery by integrating dental care into overall health policies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Finance Ministry of India**

 
 
• The Finance Ministry formulates and implements financial policies, **manages the economic framework**, and oversees the national **budget, taxation, and public expenditure.**
 
• It prepares the annual Union Budget, detailing government spending and revenue plans, and presents it in Parliament to ensure** fiscal discipline.**
 
• The ministry develops **economic policies aimed **at promoting sustainable growth, managing inflation, and ensuring financial stability.
 
• It comprises several departments, including the Department of Economic Affairs, Department of Revenue, Department of Expenditure, and Department of Financial Services, each handling specific aspects of financial governance .
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Commerce and Industry**
 
 
• The Ministry is responsible for formulating and implementing policies related to **international and domestic trade** to promote exports and manage imports.
 
• It plays a crucial role in boosting industrial growth, supporting businesses, and fostering investment opportunities to enhance **economic development**.
 
• The Ministry works to improve the ease of doing business by simplifying regulations, encouraging **foreign direct investment (FDI),** and promoting entrepreneurship.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment**
 
 
• Formulates policies for **social justice** for marginalized groups, including **Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.**
 
• Focuses on empowering **women, children, and persons with disabilities** through various schemes for equal opportunities.
 
• Oversees programs to improve living standards of vulnerable populations, providing financial assistance and skill development.
 
• Develops and implements laws like the** Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act** to ensure protection and rights for marginalized communities.
